_comment: Single source of truth for every catalog_ frozen-vocabulary CHECK constraint, consumed by both validate-template.mjs and intake-to-template.mjs so the two scripts' vocab lists can't drift apart from each other -- and checked against the LIVE constraint definition (scripts/validate-template.mjs's drift-detection check, via the catalog_check_constraint_def RPC) so they can't drift apart from the DB either. Each key is '<table>.<column>'. Update this file in the SAME commit as any migration that changes one of these CHECK constraints -- that's the whole point of this file existing.
